title: Kingshot Items Database
intro: A reference to item uses, acquisition routes and related systems in Kingshot.

truegold.title: Truegold
truegold.summary: Truegold is a late-game resource used for Truegold building stages and as an exchange input in the War Academy.
truegold.purpose: Upgrade eligible buildings and support late-game War Academy progression. Set target stages for both the Town Center and its prerequisites in the building calculator. Count only unspent Truegold as inventory. Truegold Dust and Tempered Truegold are separate materials; read each result label.
truegold.acquisition: Earned through eligible events, shops, packs, and other game systems unlocked with kingdom progression.

truegold-dust.title: Truegold Dust
truegold-dust.summary: Truegold Dust is the research material consumed by basic and advanced War Academy technologies.
truegold-dust.purpose: Fund War Academy research, including the paths that unlock T11 troops. Find the planned research, then compare its next-level requirement and your inventory in the game. The research name index alone cannot calculate its cost. Do not use the building calculator’s Truegold total as a dust requirement.
truegold-dust.acquisition: Obtained through eligible rewards and by using the War Academy exchange.

mythic-general-hero-shard.title: Mythic General Hero Shard
mythic-general-hero-shard.summary: A flexible shard used to increase the star level of an eligible Mythic hero that the player already owns.
mythic-general-hero-shard.purpose: Advance an eligible owned Mythic hero without requiring that hero's named shard. Use your hero’s current star stage to find the remaining range in the shard table. Track specific and general shards separately and check conversion eligibility in the game. Shards are separate from equipment materials.
mythic-general-hero-shard.acquisition: Available from selected events, milestone rewards, shops, and recurring progression systems.

forgehammers.title: Forgehammers
forgehammers.summary: Forge Hammers are used for Mastery Forging on gold hero gear. It requires Town Center level 20 and gold gear enhancement level 20; this is separate from ordinary enhancement XP.
forgehammers.purpose: Increase Hero Gear Mastery Forging levels after the required gear conditions are met. Choose a target mastery level and equipment slots in the hero gear calculator. Subtract owned hammers from the result to plan the remainder. Do not combine enhancement XP or exclusive widgets with hammer inventory.
forgehammers.acquisition: Available from selected events, shops, reward chests, and progression milestones.

transfer-passes.title: Transfer Passes
transfer-passes.summary: Transfer Passes are consumable items required to move an eligible character to another kingdom.
transfer-passes.purpose: Pay the pass requirement calculated by the game for a Kingdom Transfer. Check the destination kingdom, eligibility and actual pass requirement in the game before preparing a transfer. This page explains the item; it does not calculate an account-specific quantity from power.
transfer-passes.acquisition: Available through the Alliance Shop and eligible paid packs; the required amount depends on the live transfer score.
